svg.title: BPE: the merge table IS the tokenizer
svg.desc: A four-step hand-drawn sequence in which the string 'low lower lowest' is written one box per byte, the most frequent adjacent pair 'lo' is counted and fused, then fused again into 'low', while a merge table on the right grows from the 256 raw byte entries to entries 256 and 257 and the words 'lower' and 'lowest' end up spelled from those merges; underneath, four bars compare gpt2, cl100k_base, Llama 3 and o200k_base on the same ten megabytes of Wikipedia, with a crossed-out word-level tokenizer below them.
svg.text: BPE: the merge table IS the tokenizer
start: every byte is its own token
a word it never saw is still spellable
the same 10 MB of English Wikipedia, four tokenizers
500k vocab, dies on the first typo
